# CSS and JavaScript

#### Course: Learn HTML

## CSS and JavaScript

With CSS, we can style the appearance of our HTML structure. CSS can be used to change

- colors
- font
- spacing
- layout, etc.

![A webpage styled using CSS.](data:image/png;base64,)

With JavaScript, we can add interactive functionality to the webpage.

For example, when a button is clicked, we can show a popup form.

![An interactive webpage with JavaScript.](data:image/png;base64,)

In this course, we will only focus on HTML (i.e., creating webpages without style and interactivity).

We will learn about CSS and JavaScript in the upcoming courses.
